exact_statement: For every even d>=4 and every Boolean sign g on r>=1 disjoint physical bits, let b(y)=(-1)^(sum_j y_(2j-1)y_(2j)), delta=2^-d, t=2^(-d/2), and F=b(y)+1[y=0](g(x)-1). Write hat b(R)=sigma_R t and a_V=hat g(V). For each relevant gate query i, retaining the residual gate mask V and sigma_R preserves the complete normalized derivative/reference KL exactly. Retaining only V loses influence-weighted KL L_i=delta a_i^2 D0_i, where D0_i=sum_sigma N_sigma delta log2(rho_i/c_(i,sigma)), N_sigma=(2^d+sigma 2^(d/2))/2, rho_i=1-delta+delta(a_empty^2+a_i^2), c_(i,sigma)=(sigma+t(a_empty-1))^2+delta a_i^2. The combined gate-row losses satisfy 0<=sum_i L_i<=2delta sum_i a_i^2<=2delta <=Inf_(y_1)(F)/4, and Inf_(y_j)(F)=1/2+delta(1-a_empty). This is a dedicated single reserve for precisely these quotient losses; no other charge, universal terminal payment, non-flat-core extension or full FEI conclusion is asserted.
hypotheses: Uniform finite physical Boolean cube; entropy and KL in bits
Even d>=4; specified quadratic bent core; any r>=1 and any Boolean gate on disjoint bits
Complete row laws mu_i(T)=p_(T+i)/e_i and r_i(T)=p_T+p_(T+i); irrelevant queries omitted
If a_i=0 the exceptional derivative cell has zero weight; no conditioning of reference on derivative support
The reserved quarter of Inf_(y_1) is dedicated only to the sum of the specified quotient losses

proof_source.locator: Signed conditional partition for arbitrary gates; complete derivation and single physical reserve
